issues.cause: Request timeout without proper cleanup - promise may hang after destroy()
issues.impact: Server request handlers can accumulate hanging promises, causing memory leaks and eventual server freeze
issues.fix: Add request.abort() before destroy(), implement proper error recovery, and ensure promise resolution in all cases

issues.cause: Syntax error - EOF heredoc terminator with stdin redirect
issues.impact: Script execution hangs indefinitely waiting for input
issues.fix: Remove line 100 completely - it appears to be accidental text after the script end

issues.cause: nohup with /dev/null redirection can cause process hanging if output buffer fills
issues.impact: Background processes may hang when trying to write output, causing server freeze
issues.fix: Use proper log files instead of /dev/null: nohup node openai-api-server.js > backend.log 2>&1 &

issues.cause: No error checking after starting process - PID might be captured even if process fails immediately
issues.impact: Script reports success even when server fails to start, leading to confusion and hanging operations
issues.fix: Add wait and process validation: if ! kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then return 1; fi

issues.cause: Recursive self-execution without proper process management
issues.impact: Can create multiple monitor processes that interfere with each other, causing system instability
issues.fix: Check for existing monitor process before starting: if pgrep -f 'health-monitor.sh monitor' > /dev/null; then exit 1; fi

issues.cause: Basic error handler doesn't handle async errors or uncaught rejections
issues.impact: Unhandled promise rejections can cause server to hang or crash unexpectedly
issues.fix: Add process handlers: process.on('unhandledRejection', ...) and process.on('uncaughtException', ...)

issues.cause: Promise.race timeout pattern without cleanup of original promise
issues.impact: Original API call continues running even after timeout, consuming resources
issues.fix: Implement proper cancellation using AbortController or cleanup the original request

issues.cause: Broad process killing pattern can kill unrelated processes and leave orphaned children
issues.impact: Incomplete cleanup leaves zombie processes that consume resources and ports
issues.fix: Use specific process tracking with PID files and kill process trees: kill -TERM -$pid

issues.code: Multiple identical timeout patterns at lines 107, 231, 347, 470
issues.cause: Repeated timeout handling code without centralized error management
issues.impact: Inconsistent timeout behavior across endpoints, difficult to maintain and debug
issues.fix: Create a centralized request wrapper function with proper timeout and error handling

issues.cause: Hardcoded API keys in test files (security issue)
issues.impact: Exposed credentials, but also indicates tests may fail and hang when keys are invalid
issues.fix: Use environment variables: const API_KEY = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY
